theme: Light mode default (with dark mode support). Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Authority, Clarity, Truth).

rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all financial values, estimates, confidence intervals, and technical specifications (pressure, temp, power).
Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome.
Primary accent (Klein Blue) used strictly for primary actions, active tabs, and key highlights.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.

layouts.general: High Density Grid (Mode B). Dense and compact spacing for data-heavy views.
layouts.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8. Internal padding for cards should be p-4 or p-6.
layouts.navigation: Collapsible left sidebar for main navigation (Projects, Repository, Admin Panel). Sticky top header for contextual actions (Currency Toggle, Add Row).
layouts.tables: Use dense tables with sticky headers. Columns must be well-aligned (numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned).
layouts.grid_borders: The Technical Look: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-border) with no border-radius (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) to feel like a precise engineering tool. No soft shadows.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, NO SHADOW. Hover state: border color darkens, slight background tint.
components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary button: solid Klein Blue. Secondary: solid surface color with border.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs customized to have sharp corners, 1px borders, subtle focus ring.
components.tables: Shadcn Table component. Row hover effect must be subtle (bg-slate-50). Data cells use font-mono where appropriate.
components.badges: Use sharp, bordered badges for AACE Class (e.g., Class 3: Green border, Class 4: Yellow border, Class 5: Gray border).
components.dialogs: Solid background (no glassmorphism for medical/engineering apps), stark contrast, sharp borders.

motion.micro_interactions: Minimalist. Hover states change background/border color. No bouncy or playful animations.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: expose the grid. Container items have right and bottom borders. Use 'The Technical Look'.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (dense, readable at small sizes).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI with pure HTML/Tailwind for layouts, and heavily customized Shadcn UI for interactive components.
Implement the 'Technical Look': replace all rounded-md and shadow-sm defaults in Shadcn with rounded-none and 1px sharp borders.
Use Phosphor Icons via @phosphor-icons/react. Install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Data table rows in the Project Detail view must be highly dense to allow editing multiple properties (Capacity, Pressure, Temp, etc.) inline without excessive scrolling.
Use a left sidebar for primary navigation (Dashboard, Repository, Admin) and a sticky top header for view-specific actions (e.g., 'Add Equipment', 'Currency: EUR/USD').
For the Project Detail view, use a Bento-style summary at the top (Total Cost, Confidence Interval, AACE Class) and a dense data table below for the equipment rows.
All financial values and statistical outputs must use the IBM Plex Mono font.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Left-align dense content.
Create depth through 1px crisp borders, not soft shadows.
Never apply universal 'transition: all'. Add transitions explicitly.
Do not center-align the app container.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900).
Include 'data-testid' on all buttons, inputs, and key UI elements.
